name: Desarrolloperu Libro de Reclamaciones Lite
author: desarrolloperu

sections.description:
Desarrolloperu Libro de Reclamaciones Lite is a free plugin that lets you offer a Virtual Complaints Book (Libro de Reclamaciones) on your WordPress website and manage every claim and complaint from the dashboard.

It is aimed at businesses and establishments in Peru that need to receive claims and complaints from their customers through the Internet. The plugin interface is in Spanish.

Key Features

  • Public form for claims and complaints, with data validation.
  • Unique consecutive code per year for every case.
  • Status tracking (pending, in progress, resolved, voided) and formal response by email.
  • “Validar Reclamo” page where consumers check the status of their case using the claim code and their document number.
  • PDF receipt generated automatically when a claim is registered, attached to the confirmation email and downloadable from the status page.
  • Inbox with search, pagination and a fully responsive layout.
  • Numeric summary above the inbox (last 15 days) with a date range filter.
  • Optional Cloudflare Turnstile anti-spam, configured with your own keys. No extra plugin required.
  • Built-in Help section with frequently asked questions.
  • Works without WooCommerce.

Privacy

This plugin connects to an external license validation server (desarrolloperu.com) only when the user manually enters and activates a license key in the plugin settings. No data is sent or collected automatically.

PDF receipts: when a claim is registered, the plugin generates a PDF with the same data that is sent by email to the consumer. The file is stored in a private folder (outside the public web directory when the server allows it, otherwise inside wp-content/uploads/dps_libro_files protected with an .htaccess file) and is only delivered through a unique, hard-to-guess token link shown after the consumer validates the claim code and document number.

External services

This plugin can optionally connect to Cloudflare Turnstile, a bot-detection service, to protect the public forms (claim submission and claim status lookup) against spam and automated abuse.

This connection is not automatic: it only happens if the site administrator explicitly enables the “Protección Anti-Spam” option in the plugin settings (disabled by default) and enters their own Cloudflare Turnstile Site Key and Secret Key. No additional plugin is required.

When enabled, the plugin loads Cloudflare’s Turnstile script (https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js) on those forms so that Cloudflare can run its bot-detection challenge. As part of this, the visitor’s IP address, user-agent and other browser/connection signals are sent to Cloudflare’s servers. When a form is submitted, the plugin also sends the challenge response token, the Secret Key and the visitor’s IP address from your server to Cloudflare’s verification endpoint (https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify) to confirm that the visitor is not a bot.

This service is provided by Cloudflare, Inc.:
Cloudflare Terms of Service, Cloudflare Privacy Policy, Turnstile Privacy Addendum.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the desarrolloperu-libro-de-reclamaciones-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. The plugin automatically creates the “Libro de Reclamaciones” and “Validar Reclamo” pages.
  4. Complete your business details in the plugin settings.
  5. Optional: install an SMTP plugin such as WP Mail SMTP so that emails are delivered reliably.
sections.faq:
What is Desarrolloperu Libro de Reclamaciones Lite?

A free plugin that helps you implement a Virtual Complaints Book and manage the registered claims and complaints from your dashboard.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. The Lite version can be installed and used at no cost.

Is it designed for Peru?

Yes. It is oriented towards websites and establishments operating in Peru, and its interface is in Spanish.

Does the plugin require WooCommerce?

No. It works independently and does not require WooCommerce.

Do I need another plugin for the anti-spam protection?

No. Cloudflare Turnstile is built in. Enable the option in the plugin settings and paste your own Site Key and Secret Key. Keys previously saved by the “Simple Cloudflare Turnstile” plugin are imported automatically.

Does the plugin generate a PDF?

Yes. When a claim is registered, a PDF receipt with the same data as the confirmation email is generated, attached to that email and made available on the “Validar Reclamo” page after the consumer enters the claim code and document number.

Where are the PDF files stored?

In a private folder: outside the public web directory when the server allows it, otherwise in wp-content/uploads/dps_libro_files, protected with an .htaccess file. Files are only delivered through a unique token link. You can choose your own folder by defining the DPS_LR_PRIVATE_DIR constant in wp-config.php.

The emails are not arriving. What can I do?

Many hosts block or filter emails sent by WordPress. Install and configure an SMTP plugin such as WP Mail SMTP.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: Cloudflare Turnstile is now built in. Keys are entered in the plugin settings and the token is verified on the server. The “Simple Cloudflare Turnstile” plugin is no longer required and its saved keys are imported.
  • New: PDF receipt generated when a claim is registered, attached to the confirmation email and downloadable from the status page through a token link. Files are stored in a private folder. No third-party PDF library is bundled.
  • New: numeric summary above the inbox (last 15 days) with a date range filter.
  • New: Help section with frequently asked questions and search.
  • New: “Type” column to tell claims and complaints apart.
  • New: the claim detail shows the registration date and the reply deadline in a highlighted card that turns red when the deadline has passed.
  • New: the status button in the claim detail changes its label, icon and color according to the selected status.
  • New: read-only preview of the response attachment field, available in the PRO version.
  • Improved: settings, claim detail and inbox are fully responsive; the inbox table becomes cards on mobile and has a better pagination.
  • Improved: public claim form layout.
  • Improved: plugin CSS and JS files are versioned by modification date to avoid stale caches.
  • Fixed: registration and resolution dates are now displayed in the site time zone (they could appear shifted when the site time zone was not UTC).

1.0.0

  • Initial stable version.
  • Initial implementation of the Virtual Complaints Book.
  • Claim registration form and management.
